title: Anilist Import List Clean Library Level Unmonitors All Series
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

If a series is removed from your list, the next import list run unmonitors all series instead of just the missing one.

### Expected Behavior

Unmonitor only the series that are missing.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Add AniList import list to import a few series.
2. Remove an anime from your AniList.
3. During the next run for that import list, all series are unmonitored instead of just the missing one.

### Environment

```markdown
- OS: TrueNAS ElectricEel-24.10.0
- Sonarr: 4.0.11.2815
- Docker Install: Yes
- Using Reverse Proxy: Yes
- Browser: Brave v1.73.104
- Database: Sqlite 3.47.1
```


### What branch are you running?

Develop

### Trace Logs?

https://privatebin.net/?c1417d9ab90ae903#6vZQwCHejXfoMrYX9tPWoKh1h9VwQuaCizJ74C1YJrWF

### Anything else?

I just noticed in my main Sonarr instance that all my anime series were marked as unmonitored, even though I had only finished one of them. I tested this in my test instance to reproduce the issue and gathered trace logs from there. This feature wasn't functioning before PR #7521, so the issue might be related to that change.
author: funforgiven
